phase0_alignment: Risk-on backdrop may support momentum but does not resolve valuation overhang.

suppression_proposals.reason: Single sell-side anchor lacks independent corroboration
suppression_proposals.evidence: All intrinsic, peer, and forecast anchors were ineligible

valuation_commentary: 估值訊號偏空，但可信度低。加權公允價值僅由分析師目標價共識支撐，缺乏可用的內在價值、同業比較與獲利預測錨點；同時自由現金流為負、資本支出高於營運現金流。風險偏好環境可能支撐股價表現，但不足以消除單一賣方錨點造成的估值不確定性。
reasoning_one_line: Single-anchor valuation indicates overvaluation with low confidence.
